name: Default
shortDescription: Peer-to-peer file transfers in the browser over WebRTC: files go straight from the sender to the recipient and are never stored on the server.

alerts.message: This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
Peers are connected through the public PeerJS signaling server (0.peerjs.com) and a public STUN server. No TURN relay is included, so transfers between peers behind strict NAT can fail.
